zh: 这条规则的净值随时间怎么走？运气的成分有多大？
en: How does this rule's wealth move over time? How large a part does luck play?

zh: 蓝色粗线是全部路径在每个时刻的净值中位数；两层蓝色的带子在每个时刻分别盖住中间 50% 和中间 90% 的净值（带子是逐个时刻算的，一条具体的路径可以进进出出）；橙线是基准的中位数。纵轴默认是对数坐标：对数坐标下，一条直线表示恒定的增长率，同样的距离表示同样的涨跌比例。
en: The thick blue line is the median wealth of all paths at each point in time; the two layers of blue bands cover, at each point in time, the middle 50% and the middle 90% of the wealth values respectively (the bands are computed one time point at a time, so a particular path can move in and out of them); the orange line is the benchmark's median. The vertical axis uses a log scale by default: on a log scale, a straight line means a constant growth rate, and the same distance means the same proportional rise or fall.

zh: 看任何一条规则的第一张图。现实里你只会走出这把扇子里的一根线，基金宣传册上那条漂亮的净值曲线也是这样的一根。这张图把其余的可能性也画了出来：带子的下沿也站在基准之上，这条规则才算稳。
en: The first chart to look at for any rule. In real life you will trace only one line of this fan, and the attractive wealth curve in a fund's brochure is one such line as well. This chart also draws the remaining possibilities: only when the lower edge of the band also stays above the benchmark does the rule count as solid.

zh: 中位数线高过基准，不等于显著，要看结果栏里的配对差。带子随时间变宽是正常的（不确定性按 √t 累积），不代表规则变差了。净值的平均值会被少数大赚的路径拉高，所以这里画的是中位数。
en: A median line above the benchmark is not the same as significance; look at the paired difference in the results bar. Bands that widen over time are normal (uncertainty accumulates in proportion to √t) and do not mean the rule has become worse. The mean of wealth is pulled up by a few paths with large gains, which is why the median is what is drawn here.

zh: 玩法里画的是每套玩法自己记的那个量（累计收益、资金、还没卖出的比例……），粗线改成各局的平均：很多玩法里这个量只取 0 或 1，中位数没有信息。
en: In the games, the chart shows the quantity that each game itself keeps track of (cumulative payoff, bankroll, the fraction not yet sold…), and the thick line is changed to the mean over episodes: in many games this quantity takes only the values 0 or 1, and the median carries no information.

zh: 这个世界生成的价格长什么样？
en: What do the prices generated by this world look like?

zh: 细线是随机挑出的二十几条样本路径，带子是全部路径在各个时刻的分位区间，粗线是中位数。真实数据用整段历史时，画的是那一条历史，阴影标出留作样本外的一段。
en: The thin lines are twenty-odd sample paths picked at random, the bands are the quantile ranges of all paths at each point in time, and the thick line is the median. When real data is used as one whole history, that single history is drawn, and shading marks the segment set aside as out-of-sample.

zh: 换了世界，或者动了世界的参数之后，先看一眼：趋势是不是太强、波动是不是太大、像不像你想模仿的那种行情。让 Claude 造了一个自定义世界之后，用它核对生成的东西是不是你要的。
en: After switching worlds, or after changing a world's parameters, take a look first: is the trend too strong, is the volatility too large, does it look like the kind of market you want to imitate? After you have asked Claude to build a custom world, use this chart to check that what is generated is what you wanted.

zh: 人眼很擅长在纯随机的路径里看出"趋势""支撑位""头肩顶"。几何布朗运动的路径里这些形态样样都有，而它们对未来毫无预测力。想知道有没有规律，看自相关图，不要看路径。
en: The human eye is very good at seeing "trends", "support levels" and "head-and-shoulders tops" in purely random paths. Paths of geometric Brownian motion contain every one of these patterns, yet the patterns have no predictive power at all about the future. To find out whether there is any regularity, look at the autocorrelation chart, not at the paths.

zh: 期末净值怎么分布？尾巴有多长，偏向哪一边？
en: How is terminal wealth distributed? How long are the tails, and to which side is it skewed?

zh: 蓝色柱子是你的规则在各条路径上的期末净值，橙色阶梯线是基准。勾上"看 log W_T"换成对数：很多步连乘之后，对数净值接近正态，形状更容易比。
en: The blue bars are your rule's terminal wealth over the paths, and the orange step line is the benchmark. Tick "Show log W_T" to switch to the logarithm: after compounding over many steps, log wealth is close to normal, and the shapes are easier to compare.

zh: 分辨两种风险形态。"多数时候小赚、偶尔大亏"的规则（输了加倍、卖出期权式的打法）左边拖着长尾；"多数时候小亏、偶尔大赚"的规则（趋势跟踪）右边拖着长尾。两者的平均值可以一样，过程中的感受和破产的风险完全不同。
en: To tell two risk profiles apart. Rules that "make a little most of the time and occasionally lose a lot" (doubling after a loss, ways of playing that resemble selling options) have a long tail on the left; rules that "lose a little most of the time and occasionally make a lot" (trend following) have a long tail on the right. The two can have the same mean, but what they feel like along the way and their risk of ruin are completely different.

zh: 平均值会被右尾拉到中位数的上方：对数正态分布里，多数路径的结果都低于平均。所以"期望收益为正"和"多数时候赚钱"不是一回事。
en: The right tail pulls the mean above the median: in a lognormal distribution, most paths end up below the mean. So "the expected return is positive" and "it makes money most of the time" are not the same thing.

zh: 玩法里是各局得分的直方图。得分只取 0 和 1 的玩法（秘书问题、翻倍或出局、自营考核）里只有两根柱子，高度就是失败率和成功率。
en: In the games, this is a histogram of the episode scores. In games where the score takes only the values 0 and 1 (the secretary problem, double or bust, the prop challenge) there are only two bars, and their heights are the failure rate and the success rate.

zh: 途中最惨的时候会跌掉多少？
en: How far does wealth fall at the worst point along the way?

zh: 每条路径算一个最大回撤：净值从此前的最高点回落的最大比例。图上是它在全部路径上的分布，对照基准。结果栏第三格里的"P(回撤 ≥ d)"就是这张图右边那一截的面积。
en: One max drawdown is computed for each path: the largest proportional fall of wealth from its previous peak. The chart shows its distribution over all paths, compared with the benchmark. The "P(drawdown ≥ d)" in the third cell of the results bar is the area of the right-hand section of this chart.

zh: 给自己定止损线、给资金定风险上限之前先看它；也用它回答"这条规则我拿得住吗"：期末赚钱的路径，途中也可能回撤过 40%。
en: Look at it before you set yourself a stop-loss line or set a risk cap for your capital; also use it to answer "would I be able to stick with this rule?": a path that ends with a profit may also have been through a 40% drawdown along the way.

zh: 回测的时间越长，最大回撤只会越大，所以长度不同的回测不能直接比。回测里见到的最大回撤只是一个下限：路径再多一些、时间再长一些，总会出现更糟的。
en: The longer the backtest, the larger the max drawdown can only become, so backtests of different lengths cannot be compared directly. The max drawdown seen in a backtest is only a lower bound: with more paths and a longer time, something worse will always appear.

zh: 这个世界每一步的收益是什么分布？尾巴厚不厚，偏不偏？
en: What is the distribution of this world's return at each step? Are the tails heavy? Is it skewed?

zh: 柱子是每一步收益的直方图，曲线是与它同均值、同方差的正态分布。柱子在两端高出曲线，就是厚尾；左右不对称，就是有偏。脚注里的偏度和峰度是这两件事的数值，正态分布的峰度是 3。
en: The bars are a histogram of the per-step returns, and the curve is the normal distribution with the same mean and the same variance. Bars that rise above the curve at both ends mean heavy tails; asymmetry between left and right means skew. The skewness and kurtosis in the footnote are the numerical values of these two things; the kurtosis of a normal distribution is 3.

zh: 决定敢用多大杠杆之前看它。Kelly 公式的近似 $f^*\approx(\mu-r_f)/\sigma^2$ 只用到了均值和方差；尾巴厚的时候，一步亏光的概率比正态告诉你的大得多，安全的杠杆要小得多。拿到一段真实数据，也先看它。
en: Look at it before deciding how much leverage you dare to use. The approximate form of the Kelly formula, $f^*\approx(\mu-r_f)/\sigma^2$, uses only the mean and the variance; when the tails are heavy, the probability of losing everything in a single step is far larger than the normal distribution tells you, and the safe leverage is far smaller. When you get a stretch of real data, look at this chart first as well.

zh: 直方图的两端裁掉了千分之几的极端值，否则中间会被压成一根线。极端值有多大，看脚注里的最小值和最大值。
en: A few tenths of a percent of extreme values are trimmed off the two ends of the histogram; otherwise the middle would be squashed into a single line. To see how large the extreme values are, look at the minimum and the maximum in the footnote.

zh: 玩法里画的是每回合出现的那个随机量（报价、需求、公司的价值）的分布。
en: In the games, the chart shows the distribution of the random quantity that appears in each round (the offer, the demand, the value of the company).

zh: 过去的收益能预测未来的收益吗？波动呢？
en: Can past returns predict future returns? What about volatility?

zh: 横轴是滞后的步数。蓝色是收益的自相关，回答方向能不能预测；橙色是收益绝对值的自相关，回答波动有没有记忆。两条虚线之间是"和零没有显著差别"的范围。
en: The horizontal axis is the lag in steps. Blue is the autocorrelation of returns, which answers whether direction can be predicted; orange is the autocorrelation of absolute returns, which answers whether volatility has memory. Between the two dashed lines is the range that is "not significantly different from zero".

zh: 面对一个陌生的世界或者一段新数据，用它定方向。蓝色在滞后 1 处显著为正，适合动量；显著为负，适合反转；蓝色全在虚线之间而橙色衰减得很慢，说明方向不可预测但波动可预测，该用的是波动率目标，不是择时（猜涨跌来决定什么时候持有）。
en: When you face an unfamiliar world or a new stretch of data, use it to decide which way to go. If blue is significantly positive at lag 1, momentum is suitable; if it is significantly negative, reversal is suitable; if blue lies entirely between the dashed lines while orange decays very slowly, direction cannot be predicted but volatility can, and what to use is volatility targeting, not market timing (guessing rises and falls to decide when to hold).

zh: 自相关只量线性关系，等于零不代表不可预测：一个序列可以线性不相关，却完全由上一步决定（Logistic 映射在 a = 4 时的取值就是这样）。反过来，自相关显著也不代表能赚钱，还要扣掉交易成本。
en: Autocorrelation measures only linear relationships, and a value of zero does not mean unpredictable: a series can be linearly uncorrelated and yet be completely determined by its previous step (the values of the Logistic map at a = 4 are exactly like this). Conversely, a significant autocorrelation does not mean you can make money either: trading costs still have to be deducted.

zh: 在一条具体的路径上，规则到底做了什么？
en: What exactly did the rule do on one particular path?

zh: 上面是价格，中间是规则每一步给出的仓位，下面是净值，对照基准。路径的编号可以改，也可以一键跳到期末净值最差、居中、最好的那一条。
en: The top panel is the price, the middle panel is the position the rule gives at each step, and the bottom panel is wealth, compared with the benchmark. You can change the path number, or jump with one click to the path with the worst, the median or the best terminal wealth.

zh: 调试规则、理解机制的时候用：买点和卖点是不是你想的那样，止损是在哪里触发的，仓位有没有在不该动的时候乱动。向别人解释一条规则时，一条具体的路径比任何统计量都直观。
en: Use it when debugging a rule or trying to understand its mechanism: are the buy points and sell points where you thought they would be, where was the stop-loss triggered, does the position move about when it should stay still? When you explain a rule to someone else, one concrete path is more intuitive than any statistic.

zh: 一条路径什么也证明不了。挑一条好看的路径来展示，是回测里最古老的自欺方式。结论要回到结果栏和分布上去下。
en: One path proves nothing. Picking a good-looking path to show is the oldest form of self-deception in backtesting. To draw conclusions, go back to the results bar and the distributions.

zh: 玩法里是一局的回放：每回合摆在面前的东西、你的动作、累计的得分，被锁住或者作废的回合有标记。回合很多时只显示其中的一段，可以前后挪，也可以看整局。
en: In the games, this is a replay of one episode: what was put in front of you in each round, your action, and the cumulative score; rounds that were locked or wasted are marked. When there are many rounds, only a section of them is shown; you can move it earlier or later, or view the whole episode.

zh: 同一条规则，把仓位整体放大或缩小，结果怎么变？押多大最好？
en: For the same rule, how do the results change when its positions are scaled up or down as a whole? What bet size is best?

zh: 横轴是倍数 λ：规则给出的每一个仓位都乘以它（规则是"固定比例"时，横轴直接是仓位比例 f）。图上方的三个按钮在三种口径之间切换。增长率先升后降，峰值处的 λ 就是这条规则的 Kelly 倍数；过了峰值处 λ 的大约两倍，增长率降到无风险利率以下。夏普几乎是平的。期望收益随杠杆一直上升，实心的点标出满足风险上限的最大值。带底色的区域是开始有路径破产的杠杆。规则是"固定比例"、世界又有理论公式（几何布朗运动、下注游戏、两点分布）时，另有一条理论曲线可以对照。
en: The horizontal axis is the multiplier λ: every position the rule gives is multiplied by it (when the rule is "Fixed fraction", the horizontal axis is the position fraction f itself). The three buttons above the chart switch between the three criteria. The growth rate first rises and then falls, and the λ at its peak is this rule's Kelly multiple; beyond about twice that λ, the growth rate falls below the risk-free rate. The Sharpe ratio is almost flat. The expected return keeps rising with leverage, and the solid dot marks the largest value that satisfies the risk cap. The shaded region is the leverage at which some paths start to be ruined. When the rule is "Fixed fraction" and the world also has a theoretical formula (geometric Brownian motion, the betting game, a two-point distribution), there is in addition a theoretical curve to compare with.

zh: 规则定下来之后，决定下多大注。也用它体会一件事：下注大小和规则好坏是两个独立的问题，一条好规则配上过大的杠杆照样破产。
en: Once the rule has been settled, use it to decide how large to bet. Also use it to appreciate one thing: bet size and rule quality are two independent questions, and a good rule paired with too much leverage is ruined all the same.

zh: 增长率的峰很平，但两边不对称：押到最优的一半，超出无风险利率的那部分增长率只少四分之一；押到最优的两倍，这部分归零（见"三种口径"里的那条抛物线）。再加上 μ 和 σ 都是估出来的，实践里常用"半 Kelly"，宁可偏左。图上的峰值来自这一批路径，本身也带着误差。
en: The peak of the growth rate is very flat, but its two sides are not symmetric: bet half of the optimum, and the part of the growth rate above the risk-free rate is only a quarter smaller; bet twice the optimum, and that part falls to zero (see the parabola in "Three criteria"). On top of that, μ and σ are both estimated, so in practice "half Kelly" is commonly used: better to err to the left. The peak on the chart comes from this batch of paths and carries an error of its own.

zh: 参数取多少最好？最好的那一点稳不稳？
en: What parameter value is best? How stable is that best point?

zh: 选一个参数，得到一条曲线：浅色的带子是 ±1 个标准误，圆点是这批路径上的最优点，竖线是当前的取值。选两个，得到一张热力图：实线框是最优的一格，虚线框是当前的取值（当前值不在格点上时不画）；点一个格子，就把参数换成它。只扫一个参数时，用图上方的"采用最优参数"。玩法里如果理论曲线算得出来，会用一条宽带画在后面，实验点应该落在带子里。
en: Choose one parameter and you get a curve: the light band is ±1 standard error, the round dot is the best point on this batch of paths, and the vertical line is the current value. Choose two and you get a heatmap: the solid frame is the best cell, and the dashed frame is the current value (not drawn when the current value is not on a grid point); click a cell to set the parameters to its values. When only one parameter is swept, use "Use the best parameters" above the chart. In the games, if the theoretical curve can be computed, it is drawn behind as a wide band, and the experimental points should fall inside the band.

zh: 调参数的主力工具。看的不是最高的那一点，而是形状：一片平缓的高原说明规则对参数不敏感，可以放心用；一个孤立的尖峰多半是噪声。也用它验证理论：理论说最优门槛是 2.01，扫一遍，看峰值是不是真在那里。
en: The main tool for tuning parameters. What to look at is not the highest point but the shape: a broad, gentle plateau means the rule is not sensitive to the parameter and can be used with confidence; an isolated spike is most likely noise. Also use it to verify theory: the theory says the optimal threshold is 2.01; run a sweep and see whether the peak really is there.

zh: 扫描本身就是在做多重比较：格子越多，最好的那一格越虚高，选定之后要用新路径检验。热力图上颜色的深浅只表示数值的高低，不表示显著；相邻格子的差别小于误差时，谁更好没有意义。
en: A sweep is itself a multiple comparison: the more cells there are, the more inflated the best cell is, and after choosing you have to test on fresh paths. On a heatmap, the depth of the color shows only how high or low the value is, not significance; when the difference between neighboring cells is smaller than the error, asking which one is better is meaningless.

zh: 几条规则放在同一批路径上，谁更好？好多少？
en: When several rules are run on the same batch of paths, which is better? By how much?

zh: 先在左栏调好一条规则，点"加入对比"把它钉住；再换一条，再钉。图上是各条规则的净值中位数，表里是各个口径的数字，最后几列是相对第一条的配对差，以及每一步决策的用时和模型的大小。
en: First tune a rule in the left column and click "Add to comparison" to pin it; then switch to another rule and pin again. The chart shows the median wealth of each rule; the table gives the numbers under each criterion, and its last few columns are the paired difference relative to the first rule, the time taken by each step's decision, and the size of the model.

zh: 两个想法之间做取舍，或者同一条规则的两组参数之间做取舍。因为所有规则跑的是同一批路径，配对差能分辨出很小的差别。
en: When choosing between two ideas, or between two sets of parameters for the same rule. Because all the rules run on the same batch of paths, the paired difference can resolve very small differences.

zh: 各条规则各自的 ± 互相重叠，不代表它们没有差别，要看配对差那一列。真实数据和 bootstrap 世界里，对比里只要有一条带训练的规则，所有规则都会改到训练段的后一部分上回测，数字会和单独跑时略有不同；模拟的世界里不受影响。
en: If the rules' individual ± ranges overlap, that does not mean there is no difference between them; look at the paired-difference column. In the real-data and bootstrap worlds, as soon as the comparison contains one rule with training, all the rules are moved to the later part of the training segment for backtesting, and the numbers differ slightly from those obtained when a rule is run on its own; simulated worlds are not affected.

zh: 赚得多的路径和回撤大的路径，是不是同一批？
en: Are the paths that earn a lot and the paths with large drawdowns the same paths?

zh: 每个点是一条路径：横轴是它途中的最大回撤，纵轴是期末净值（对数坐标）。点一个点，就打开那条路径的明细。
en: Each point is one path: the horizontal axis is its max drawdown along the way, and the vertical axis is its terminal wealth (log scale). Click a point to open the detail of that path.

zh: 看收益和风险是怎么搭配的。点云从左上向右下倾斜，说明回撤大的路径最后也亏；右上角如果也有不少点，说明有些路径是大起大落之后才赚到钱的，那样的钱你未必拿得住。
en: To see how return and risk go together. A point cloud that slopes from the upper left to the lower right means that paths with large drawdowns also end with a loss; if there are also quite a few points in the upper right corner, some paths made their money only after large swings up and down, and that is money you might not hold on long enough to collect.

zh: 只画了 600 条路径的抽样。破产的路径净值是 0，对数坐标上画不出来，要看结果栏下面那行小字里的破产概率。
en: Only a sample of 600 paths is drawn. A ruined path has wealth 0 and cannot be drawn on a log scale; look at the ruin probability in the line of small print under the results bar.

zh: 模型到底学到了一个什么样的函数？和真相差多少？
en: Exactly what kind of function has the model learned? How far is it from the truth?

zh: 横轴是第一个特征，纵轴是模型预测的下一步收益。蓝线是模型；橙点是把训练数据按这个特征分成 20 组之后每组的平均实际收益，带着误差棒；在真相写得出来的世界里，绿色的宽带是真实的条件期望。
en: The horizontal axis is the first feature, and the vertical axis is the next-step return predicted by the model. The blue line is the model; the orange points are the mean actual return of each group after the training data is split into 20 groups by this feature, with error bars; in worlds where the truth can be written down, the wide green band is the true conditional expectation.

zh: 模型回测赚钱了，把钱交给它之前要问：它到底学到了什么？这张图检查模型是不是学对了东西。蓝线落在绿带里，学对了；蓝线跟着橙点的每一个抖动走，是在拟合噪声；蓝线是一条直线而绿带是一条抛物线，是模型的类型选错了：线性模型学不了非线性的规律。
en: The model made money in the backtest; before you hand it your money, ask: what exactly has it learned? This chart checks whether the model has learned the right thing. If the blue line lies inside the green band, it has; if the blue line follows every wiggle of the orange points, it is fitting noise; if the blue line is straight while the green band is a parabola, the wrong type of model was chosen: a linear model cannot learn a nonlinear pattern.

zh: 只画了沿第一个特征的一刀，其余特征固定在平均值上。特征之间有交互时，这一刀看不到全貌。
en: Only a single slice along the first feature is drawn, with the other features held at their means. When features interact, this slice does not show the whole picture.

zh: 模型的预测准不准？有没有过拟合？
en: Are the model's predictions accurate? Is it overfitting?

zh: 把验证集的样本按预测值从低到高分成十组，横轴是每组的平均预测，纵轴是每组的平均实际收益。点落在虚线上，说明预测的大小是对的，不只是方向。图下面一行给出训练集和验证集的 R²、IC（预测值与实际值的相关系数）、方向命中率（预测对了涨跌方向的比例），以及模型存了多少个数、预测一次要多久。
en: The validation-set samples are sorted by predicted value from low to high and split into ten groups; the horizontal axis is each group's mean prediction, and the vertical axis is each group's mean actual return. Points on the dashed line mean the size of the prediction is right, not only the direction. The line below the chart gives the training-set and validation-set R², the IC (the correlation coefficient between predicted and actual values), the directional hit rate (the share of predictions that got the direction of the move right), how many numbers the model stores, and how long one prediction takes.

zh: 任何带训练的规则（先在另一批数据上拟合出模型、再用它做决定的规则），先看它，再看净值。验证集 R² 不大于 0 的模型，净值曲线再好看也是运气。训练集 R² 远高于验证集，就是过拟合。
en: For any rule with training (a rule that first fits a model on a separate batch of data and then uses it to make decisions), look at this chart first and at wealth afterwards. For a model whose validation-set R² is not greater than 0, the wealth curve is luck, however good it looks. A training-set R² far above that of the validation set is overfitting.

zh: 金融收益的 R² 天然很小：每天一个数据点时，0.5% 已经是很强的预测力，对应的年化夏普在 1 以上（按预测的大小下注时，每一步的夏普约等于 √R²（预测校准时它就是 IC），年化再乘 √252：√0.005 × √252 ≈ 1.1）。见到百分之几十的 R²，先怀疑特征里漏进了未来的数据。这个实验室里的物理世界（Logistic 映射、洛伦兹系统）R² 可以接近 1，那是因为它们本来就是确定性的。
en: The R² of financial returns is naturally very small: with one data point per day, 0.5% is already strong predictive power, and the corresponding annualized Sharpe ratio is above 1 (when you bet according to the size of the prediction, the Sharpe ratio per step is approximately √R² (which is the IC when the prediction is calibrated), and annualizing multiplies it by √252: √0.005 × √252 ≈ 1.1). When you see an R² of tens of percent, first suspect that future data has leaked into the features. In this lab's physics worlds (the Logistic map, the Lorenz system) R² can be close to 1; that is because they are deterministic in the first place.

zh: 模型的预测靠的是哪个特征？
en: Which feature do the model's predictions depend on?

zh: 每根柱子对应一个特征：把验证集里这个特征的取值随机打乱，模型的 R² 会下降多少。下降得多，说明模型离不开它；接近 0 或者为负，说明它没有被用上，或者被用错了。
en: Each bar corresponds to one feature: how much the model's R² falls when the values of that feature in the validation set are randomly shuffled. A large fall means the model cannot do without the feature; a fall close to 0 or negative means the feature is not being used, or is being used wrongly.

zh: 模型用了 8 个特征，回测赚钱了。它到底靠的是哪一个？特征多了之后用这张图做减法：没用的特征只会增加估计的噪声。也用来核对模型的逻辑：如果一个你认为不相干的特征最重要，要么你想错了，要么数据里漏进了未来的信息。
en: The model uses 8 features, and it made money in the backtest. Which one is it really relying on? Once there are many features, use this chart to cut them down: a useless feature only adds estimation noise. Also use it to check the model's logic: if a feature you believe to be irrelevant is the most important one, either you are mistaken or future information has leaked into the data.

zh: 两个特征高度相关时，打乱其中一个，模型还能从另一个得到差不多的信息，两者的重要性都会被低估。
en: When two features are highly correlated, shuffling one of them leaves the model still able to get much the same information from the other, so the importance of both is underestimated.

zh: 同一个世界里，十种模型谁预测得准，谁赚得多，谁算得快？
en: In the same world, which of the ten models predicts most accurately, which earns the most, and which computes fastest?

zh: 把规则里的一个选项（默认是"用哪个模型"）逐个换一遍，各自训练、回测。上面的面板是训练集和验证集的 R²，两点之间的距离就是过拟合的程度；下面的面板是长期增长率。图下的表给出每个模型的训练用时、预测一次的用时和存了多少个数。点图上的一个点，就换成那个模型。
en: One option in the rule (by default "which model to use") is switched through its values one by one, each trained and backtested separately. The upper panel is the training-set and validation-set R²; the distance between the two points is the degree of overfitting. The lower panel is the long-run growth rate. The table below the chart gives, for each model, the training time, the time for one prediction and how many numbers it stores. Click a point on the chart to switch to that model.

zh: 认识各种建模方法的脾气。线性的世界里（AR(1)、带噪谐振子）线性回归就够了，更复杂的模型只会更差；非线性的世界里（Logistic 映射）线性回归的 R² 封顶在一半，k 近邻、树和神经网络能学到全部。同时看到代价：灵活的模型要多训练多久、多存多少东西。现实里的用法：研究员手里有一个预测目标和一批特征，先用它回答"这个问题需要多复杂的模型"，再决定往哪里花力气。
en: To get to know the temperament of each modeling method. In linear worlds (AR(1), the noisy oscillator) linear regression is enough, and more complex models only do worse; in nonlinear worlds (the Logistic map) the R² of linear regression is capped at one half, while k-nearest neighbors, trees and neural networks can learn all of it. You also see the cost: how much longer a flexible model takes to train, and how much more it stores. The real-world use: a researcher has a prediction target and a set of features, first uses this chart to answer the question "how complex a model does this problem need?" and only then decides where to put the effort.

zh: 预测最准的模型不一定赚得最多：仓位怎么随预测变、换手多少，同样决定收益。比了十个，最好的那个要打折扣（见"结果可信吗"）。用时是在你这台设备上现测的，换一台机器会变，相对的快慢不大会变。
en: The model that predicts most accurately does not necessarily earn the most: how the position changes with the prediction, and how much turnover there is, likewise determine the return. Ten were compared, so the best one has to be discounted (see "Can you trust the result?"). The timings are measured live on your device; they will change on another machine, but the relative speeds will not change much.

zh: 这条规则换一个世界还行不行？这个世界里哪条规则最好？
en: Does this rule still work in a different world? Which rule is best in this world?

zh: 两种看法，用上面的按钮切换。"这条规则 × 各个场景"：当前的规则和参数原样拿到每个场景里各跑一遍。"这个场景 × 各条规则"：各条规则在当前的世界里各跑一遍（带训练的规则要勾上"包括要训练的规则"才列进来）。每一行是一次回测：条形的长度是所选的指标，细线是 ±2 个标准误，▲▼ 表示和基准的配对差是否显著。个别比其余的大出好几倍的值会被截短，条上画着斜纹，长度不再按比例，数值照常写在右边。行尾的按钮把世界或者规则切过去。一次对比用的是开始那一刻的设定；中途改了世界、规则或参数，表上会注明"这是上一次的结果"。玩法里计分办法不同的场景分开画，不放在一根轴上。
en: There are two views; switch between them with the buttons at the top. "This rule × every scenario": the current rule and its parameters are taken unchanged into every scenario and run once in each. "This scenario × every rule": every rule is run once in the current world (rules with training are listed only if you tick "Include rules that need training"). Each row is one backtest: the length of the bar is the selected metric, the thin line is ±2 standard errors, and ▲▼ indicate whether the paired difference from the benchmark is significant. An occasional value that is several times larger than the rest is cut short: the bar is drawn with diagonal stripes, its length is no longer to scale, and the value is written on the right as usual. The button at the end of a row switches to that world or that rule. A comparison uses the settings as they were at the moment it started; if the world, the rule or the parameters are changed along the way, the table notes that "these are the results from the last run". In the games, scenarios with different scoring methods are drawn separately rather than on one axis.

zh: 回答"这条规则的应用场景是什么"。只在个别世界里赢的规则，靠的是那种世界特有的结构；到处都略赢一点的，多半只是加了杠杆。也用它在动手调参数之前先选对规则的类型。
en: To answer the question "What are this rule's use cases?" A rule that wins only in a few worlds relies on structure specific to that kind of world; one that wins by a little everywhere has most likely only added leverage. Also use it to pick the right type of rule before you start tuning parameters.

zh: 规则的参数没有按场景重新调：一条规则在别的世界里表现差，可能只是参数不合适。行数就是比较的次数，最好的那一行同样要打折扣。手册"对照表"一页里有一张全表（在你的电脑上现算）。
en: The rule's parameters are not re-tuned for each scenario: a rule that does poorly in another world may only have unsuitable parameters. The number of rows is the number of comparisons, and the best row has to be discounted in the same way. The handbook page "Comparison table" has a full table (computed live on your computer).

zh: 手册自己的用词
en: The handbook's own terms

zh: 数据的来源：数据服从的那个分布或者过程。可以是一个随机模型、一种分布、一枚硬币，或者一段真实的行情。同一种玩法可以换不同的世界。
en: The source of the data: the distribution or process that the data follows. It can be a stochastic model, a distribution, a coin, or a stretch of real market data. The same game can be played in different worlds.

zh: 你定的决策办法，也就是通常说的策略；玩法里也叫打法。每一步（每回合）它看到当时的信息，给出一个动作。
en: The decision method you choose, which is what is usually called a strategy; in the games it is also called a way of playing. At each step (each round) it sees the information available at that moment and returns an action.

zh: 玩法和世界自己的规定：数据怎么来、你能做什么、怎么结算、怎么计分。它不由你定。手册顶上的"当前的细则"把眼下这一套完整地写出来。
en: The game's and the world's own regulations: where the data comes from, what you can do, how outcomes are settled, and how the score is computed. It is not up to you. "Current rulebook" at the top of the handbook writes out the present set in full.

zh: 题目的类型：每一步你看到什么、能做什么动作、怎么结算、怎么计分。数据服从什么分布不归它管，那是世界的事。有"交易一个资产"、十套回合制的小游戏和四套观测玩法。
en: The type of problem: what you see at each step, which actions you can take, how outcomes are settled, and how the score is computed. Which distribution the data follows is not its concern; that is the world's business. There are "Trade one asset", ten round-based mini-games, and four observation games.

zh: 场景
en: Scenario

zh: 同一个世界、同一套玩法，换一组参数就是一个场景。"对照表"里的一列、"场景对比"里的一行。
en: For the same world and the same game, each set of parameters is a scenario. It is one column in the "Comparison table" and one row in "Scenario comparison".

zh: 局 / 回合
en: Episode / round

zh: 一局是从头到尾完整的一场；里面的一步叫回合（有的玩法里叫次、把、天、期）。页面一次打很多局，得分是各局的平均。
en: An episode is one complete run from start to finish; a step within it is called a round (in some games a flip, a bet, a day or a period). The page plays many episodes at a time, and the score is the average over the episodes.

zh: 结果栏
en: Results bar

zh: 页面中间最上面、标题写着"结果"的那一块：几个总的数字，以及和基准的比较。
en: The block at the very top of the middle of the page, with the heading "Results": a few summary numbers, and the comparison with the benchmark.

zh: 口径
en: Criterion

zh: 衡量"好不好"的尺子。价格世界里并排给三种：长期增长率、夏普比率、带风险上限的期望收益。
en: The yardstick that measures "how good". In the price worlds three are given side by side: long-run growth rate, Sharpe ratio, and expected return with a risk cap.

zh: 用来比较的参照，是不动脑筋也做得到的做法。价格世界里是买入持有，下注游戏里是不下注，每套玩法有它自己的基准规则。
en: The reference used for comparison: something that can be done without any thought. In the price worlds it is "Buy and hold"; in the betting game it is "No bet"; each game has its own benchmark rule.

zh: 玩法里衡量一条规则的那个数，通常每一局算一个，再对全部对局取平均。
en: The number by which a game measures a rule, usually computed once per episode and then averaged over all episodes.

zh: 带训练的规则
en: Rule with training

zh: 先在另一批数据上拟合出一个模型、再用它做决定的规则。那批数据叫训练路径：模拟的世界里是另外生成的一批；真实数据里是训练段的前 60%。
en: A rule that first fits a model on a separate batch of data and then uses it to make decisions. That batch of data is called the training paths: in a simulated world it is a separately generated batch; in real data it is the first 60% of the training segment.

zh: 规则说明里的档位之一：在所述的模型和目标下，可以证明它是最优的。
en: One of the tiers in a rule's notes: under the stated model and objective, it can be proved to be optimal.

zh: 档位之一：只在这一族规则之内，通过选参数达到最优；族外可能有更好的。
en: One of the tiers: optimal only within this family of rules, by choice of parameters; outside the family there may be something better.

zh: 档位之一：有可以证明的性能保证（比如遗憾的上界、收敛到最优），但本身不是最优的。
en: One of the tiers: it has a provable performance guarantee (for example an upper bound on regret, or convergence to the optimum), but it is not itself optimal.

zh: 档位之一：凭经验和直觉定的规则，没有最优性的保证。
en: One of the tiers: a rule set by experience and intuition, with no guarantee of optimality.

zh: 仓位与交易
en: Positions and trading

zh: 持仓市值占净值的比例，记作 f。1 是满仓，0 是空仓，0.5 是一半的钱买了资产。
en: The market value of the holding as a fraction of wealth, written f. 1 is fully invested, 0 is flat, and 0.5 means half of the money is in the asset.

zh: 做多
en: Long

zh: 买入并持有，价格涨了赚钱。仓位为正。与做空相对。
en: Buying the asset and holding it, which makes money when the price rises. The position is positive. The opposite of going short.

zh: 做空
en: Short

zh: 仓位为负：借来资产先卖掉，等跌了再买回来还。价格上涨时亏钱，而且亏损没有上限。A 股里借股票来卖叫融券。
en: A negative position: you borrow the asset and sell it first, then buy it back to return it once the price has fallen. You lose money when the price rises, and the loss has no upper limit. In the A-share market, borrowing shares in order to sell them is called securities lending.

zh: 杠杆
en: Leverage

zh: 借钱买资产，使仓位超过 1；几倍杠杆就是 f 等于几。f = 2 表示借了与本金等额的钱，买入两倍于本金的资产；资产跌 50% 就亏光。
en: Borrowing money to buy the asset, so that the position exceeds 1; the leverage multiple is the value of f. f = 2 means you have borrowed an amount equal to your own capital and bought assets worth twice your capital; if the asset falls 50%, everything is lost.

zh: 调仓 / 加仓 / 减仓
en: Rebalance / add to / reduce a position

zh: 调仓是把仓位改到新的目标；加仓、减仓是调大、调小。
en: Rebalancing changes the position to a new target; adding to the position and reducing it mean making it larger and smaller.

zh: 开仓 / 平仓
en: Open / close a position

zh: 开仓是从空仓变成有仓位；平仓是把仓位调回 0。
en: Opening a position is going from flat to holding a position; closing it is bringing the position back to 0.

zh: 长期留着不动的那部分持仓。A 股里"做 T"就是在底仓上日内来回买卖。
en: The part of the holding that is kept untouched for the long term. In the A-share market, "T+0 round trips" are intraday trades back and forth on top of the base position.

zh: 择时
en: Market timing

zh: 根据对涨跌的判断，决定什么时候持有、什么时候空仓。与"始终按固定比例持有"相对。
en: Deciding when to hold and when to be flat, based on a judgment about whether the price will rise or fall. The opposite of "always holding a fixed fraction".

zh: 止损 / 止盈
en: Stop-loss / take-profit

zh: 亏到（或赚到）事先定好的幅度就卖出离场。那个价位叫止损线（止盈线）。
en: Selling and leaving the market once the loss (or the gain) reaches a size fixed in advance. That price is called the stop-loss line (take-profit line).

zh: 涨了卖一点，跌了买回来，赚来回波动的钱。
en: Sell a little after a rise and buy it back after a fall, making money from the back-and-forth swings.

zh: 回调 / 反手
en: Pullback / reversing a position

zh: 回调是上涨途中短暂的下跌。反手是从做多直接翻成做空，或者反过来。
en: A pullback is a brief fall in the middle of a rise. Reversing a position is going directly from long to short, or the other way around.

zh: 换手
en: Turnover

zh: 一段时间里买卖的总金额相对净值的倍数。仓位从 0 调到 1 再调回 0，换手是 2。
en: The total amount bought and sold over a period, as a multiple of wealth. If the position goes from 0 to 1 and back to 0, turnover is 2.

zh: 交易成本
en: Trading cost

zh: 每笔买卖付出的代价：佣金、税、买卖价差。这里按"换手 × 单边成本"扣。
en: The price paid on each trade: commission, taxes, the bid–ask spread. Here it is charged as "turnover × one-way cost".

zh: 单边
en: One-way

zh: 买和卖各收一次。一买一卖的来回要付两次。
en: Charged once on a buy and once on a sell. A round trip of one buy and one sell pays it twice.

zh: 基点（bp）
en: Basis point (bp)

zh: 万分之一。5 bp = 0.05%。交易成本和费率习惯用它。
en: One ten-thousandth. 5 bp = 0.05%. Trading costs and fee rates are customarily quoted in it.

zh: 买卖价差
en: Bid–ask spread

zh: 此刻市场上最低的卖价减去最高的买价。想立刻成交的人要付出它。
en: The lowest ask price in the market at this moment minus the highest bid price. Anyone who wants to trade immediately has to pay it.

zh: 限价单
en: Limit order

zh: "不比这个价差才成交"的挂单，挂出去等别人来成交。
en: A resting order that says "trade only at a price no worse than this one"; it is posted and waits for someone else to trade against it.

zh: 做市商
en: Market maker

zh: 同时挂出一个买价和一个稍高的卖价、随时愿意和任何人成交的交易者。赚两者之间的差价，承担手里存货涨跌的风险。
en: A trader who posts a bid price and a slightly higher ask price at the same time and is willing to trade with anyone at any moment. A market maker earns the difference between the two and bears the risk that the inventory on hand rises or falls in price.

zh: 冲击成本
en: Market impact cost

zh: 你自己的买卖把价格推向不利方向造成的损失。单子越大、成交越急，冲击越大。分为过后会恢复的临时冲击和不会恢复的永久冲击。
en: The loss caused by your own buying and selling pushing the price in the unfavorable direction. The larger the order and the more urgent the execution, the larger the impact. It is divided into temporary impact, which recovers afterwards, and permanent impact, which does not.

zh: 跳空
en: Gap

zh: 价格不经过中间的价位，从一个价直接跳到另一个价。设在中间的止损只能成交在更差的位置。
en: The price jumps directly from one price to another without passing through the prices in between. A stop-loss set in between can only be filled at a worse price.

zh: 净值与收益
en: Wealth and returns

zh: 账户的总价值，开局记为 1。净值 1.3 表示赚了 30%。下注游戏和十套玩法里叫资金，是同一个东西。
en: The total value of the account, set to 1 at the start. Wealth of 1.3 means a gain of 30%. In the betting game and the ten games it is called the bankroll; it is the same thing.

zh: 终值
en: Terminal wealth

zh: 期末的净值，记作 W_T。
en: Wealth at the end of the horizon, written W_T.

zh: 收益率
en: Return

zh: 一步之内价格的变化比例，r = 新价/旧价 − 1。玩法里说的"收益"有时指进账的钱数（比如"平均每回合收益"），看上下文。
en: The proportional change in price within one step, r = new price/old price − 1. In the games, "return" or "payoff" sometimes means the amount of money received (for example "Average payoff per round"); the context tells which.

zh: 对数收益
en: Log return

zh: ln(新价/旧价)。好处是可以相加：多步的对数收益等于各步之和。幅度小时与收益率几乎相等。手册的公式里写 log 的地方，指的都是自然对数 ln。
en: ln(new price/old price). Its advantage is that it adds up: the log return over several steps equals the sum of the log returns of the individual steps. For small moves it is almost equal to the return. Wherever the handbook's formulas write log, the natural logarithm ln is meant.

zh: 年化
en: Annualized

zh: 把每一步的量换算成每年的量：均值乘以每年的步数 K，标准差乘以 √K。
en: A per-step quantity converted into a per-year quantity: the mean is multiplied by the number of steps per year K, and the standard deviation by √K.

zh: 价格每年平均上涨的比例。它决定方向，但从数据里很难估准：用 n 年的数据估 μ，标准误是 σ/√n。
en: The average proportional rise of the price per year. It determines the direction, but it is very hard to estimate accurately from data: when μ is estimated from n years of data, the standard error is σ/√n.

zh: 收益率的标准差，通常年化。它决定不确定性的大小，而且比 μ 好估得多。
en: The standard deviation of returns, usually annualized. It determines the size of the uncertainty, and it is much easier to estimate than μ.

zh: 现金存着就能拿到的利率，记作 r_f。所有收益都应该和它比。
en: The interest rate that cash earns merely by being held on deposit, written r_f. Every return should be compared with it.

zh: 超额收益
en: Excess return

zh: 收益减去无风险利率。夏普比率的分子。
en: Return minus the risk-free rate. The numerator of the Sharpe ratio.

zh: 净值从此前最高点回落的比例。
en: The fraction by which wealth has fallen from its previous highest point.

zh: 一段时间里出现过的最大的回撤。
en: The largest drawdown that has occurred over a period.

zh: 净值跌到 0 或以下。发生之后这条路径就结束了。
en: Wealth falls to 0 or below. Once this happens, the path is over.

zh: 开局满仓买入，一直拿着不动。
en: Buy at the start, fully invested, and hold without ever touching the position.

zh: 套 / 踏空
en: Trapped / missing the rally

zh: 买进之后跌了、卖出就要认亏，叫被套。卖早了、没赶上后面的上涨，叫踏空。
en: When the price has fallen after you bought, so that selling means accepting a loss, you are said to be trapped. When you sold too early and missed the rise that followed, you are said to have missed the rally.

zh: 三种口径与下注大小
en: The three criteria and bet sizing

zh: E[log W_T]/年数：钱利滚利时的增长速度。见"三种口径"。
en: E[log W_T]/(number of years): the speed at which money grows when gains are compounded. See "Three criteria".

zh: 超额收益的均值除以标准差，再年化。见"三种口径"。
en: The mean of the excess return divided by its standard deviation, then annualized. See "Three criteria".

zh: E[W_T] − 1：整段时间平均赚多少，不年化。第三种口径里它要配上风险上限才有意义。
en: E[W_T] − 1: how much is made on average over the whole time span, not annualized. In the third criterion it is meaningful only when paired with the risk cap.

zh: 第三种口径的约束：最大回撤达到 d 的路径不能超过比例 α。两个数在左栏改。
en: The constraint of the third criterion: the fraction of paths whose max drawdown reaches d must not exceed α. You change both numbers in the left column.

zh: Kelly 比例
en: Kelly fraction

zh: 使长期增长率最高的下注比例。抛硬币时是 f* = p − (1−p)/b（p 是胜率，b 是赔率：赢了净得赌注的几倍），连续时间里是 (μ − r_f)/σ²，r_f 是无风险利率。
en: The betting fraction that maximizes the long-run growth rate. For coin flips it is f* = p − (1−p)/b (p is the win probability and b is the odds: the multiple of the stake that you net when you win); in continuous time it is (μ − r_f)/σ², where r_f is the risk-free rate.

zh: 只押 Kelly 比例的一半。超出无风险利率的那部分增长率只损失四分之一，波动减半，对参数估错也宽容得多。
en: Betting only half of the Kelly fraction. The part of the growth rate in excess of the risk-free rate falls by only a quarter, volatility is halved, and it is much more forgiving of errors in the estimated parameters.

zh: 每一注的期望收益为正的那一部分。抛硬币时每押 1 块钱的期望是 pb − (1 − p)（赔率 b = 1 时就是 2p − 1）；自营考核里指漂移 μ。
en: The amount by which the expected return on each bet is positive. For coin flips, the expectation per 1 dollar staked is pb − (1 − p) (which is 2p − 1 when the odds are b = 1); in the prop-firm challenge it means the drift μ.

zh: 效用 / 风险厌恶
en: Utility / risk aversion

zh: 效用是把钱数换算成"满意程度"的函数 U，目标写成 E[U(W_T)] 最大。U 取对数就是第一种口径（也叫对数最优）；U(W) = −exp(−aW) 叫指数效用。U 弯得越厉害越不肯冒险，这叫风险厌恶。
en: Utility is a function U that converts an amount of money into a "degree of satisfaction"; the objective is written as maximizing E[U(W_T)]. Taking U to be the logarithm gives the first criterion (also called log-optimal); U(W) = −exp(−aW) is called exponential utility. The more sharply U bends, the less willing you are to take risk; this is called risk aversion.

zh: 统计与检验
en: Statistics and testing

zh: 路径
en: Path

zh: 一条完整的价格序列，一次可能的"历史"。一批有 N 条，互相独立。
en: A path is one complete price series, one possible "history". A batch has N of them, independent of one another.

zh: 步
en: Step

zh: 两次决策之间的时间间隔。每年 252 步时，一步是一个交易日（也说日线、日频：每天一个数据点，每天决策一次）。
en: The time interval between two decisions. With 252 steps per year, one step is one trading day (also called daily bars or daily frequency: one data point per day, one decision per day).

zh: 决定这一批随机数的那个整数。种子相同，生成的路径完全相同。
en: The integer that determines this batch of random numbers. With the same seed, the generated paths are exactly the same.

zh: 蒙特卡洛
en: Monte Carlo

zh: 用大量随机抽样来估计一个量。这里的每个数字都是这样算出来的。
en: Estimating a quantity by drawing a large number of random samples. Every number here is computed this way.

zh: 回测
en: Backtest

zh: 把一条规则放到一段（历史的或模拟的）数据上，看它当时会怎样。
en: Running a rule on a stretch of (historical or simulated) data to see how it would have done at the time.

zh: 随机量的平均值，记作 E[·]。
en: The average value of a random quantity, written E[·].

zh: 排在正中间的那个值：一半的结果比它好，一半比它差。
en: The value ranked exactly in the middle: half of the outcomes are better than it and half are worse.

zh: 分位数
en: Quantile

zh: u 分位数是这样一个值：有比例为 u 的结果不超过它。中位数就是 0.5 分位数。
en: The u-quantile is the value such that a fraction u of the outcomes do not exceed it. The median is the 0.5-quantile.

zh: 方差 / 标准差
en: Variance / standard deviation

zh: 方差是"与均值之差的平方"的平均，记作 Var；标准差是它的平方根，和原来的量同一个单位。两个数量的都是取值有多分散。成本以 % 计时，方差的单位是 %²。
en: Variance is the average of "the squared difference from the mean", written Var; the standard deviation is its square root and has the same unit as the original quantity. Both numbers measure how spread out the values are. When cost is measured in %, the unit of variance is %².

zh: 标准误
en: Standard error

zh: 一个估计值的不确定程度：换一批样本重算，它大约会变动这么多。N 个独立样本的均值，标准误是 标准差/√N。
en: How uncertain an estimate is: recompute it on another batch of samples and it will change by roughly this much. For the mean of N independent samples, the standard error is standard deviation/√N.

zh: 显著
en: Significant

zh: 差别大到不太可能只是运气。这里的门槛是：差的绝对值超过 2 个标准误。
en: A difference so large that it is unlikely to be luck alone. The threshold here is that the absolute value of the difference exceeds 2 standard errors.

zh: 两条规则在同一批路径上逐条相减再平均。共有的运气被抵消，比分别算再相减准得多。
en: The results of two rules on the same batch of paths are subtracted path by path and then averaged. The luck they share cancels, so this is far more accurate than computing each separately and then subtracting.

zh: 样本内 / 样本外
en: In-sample / out-of-sample

zh: 调参数时看过的数据是样本内，没看过的是样本外。只有样本外的结果能说明规则在将来怎么样。
en: Data that was looked at while tuning the parameters is in-sample; data that was not is out-of-sample. Only out-of-sample results can tell you how the rule will do in the future.

zh: 真实数据里用来调参数的前一段（默认前 70%）；后一段留作样本外。
en: In real data, the earlier segment that is used for tuning parameters (by default the first 70%); the later segment is kept as out-of-sample.

zh: 过拟合
en: Overfitting

zh: 规则或模型迎合了手头这批数据里的偶然性，换一批数据就不灵了。参数越多、调得越细，越容易发生。
en: The rule or model has adapted to accidental features of the batch of data at hand and stops working on another batch. The more parameters there are and the more finely they are tuned, the more easily it happens.

zh: 多重比较
en: Multiple comparisons

zh: 同时试很多个方案，再挑最好的。试得越多，最好的那个越可能只是运气最好。
en: Trying many alternatives at once and then picking the best. The more you try, the more likely it is that the best one is merely the luckiest.

zh: 每一步都从同一个分布里重新抽一次，和之前抽到什么无关。这时过去对未来没有任何预测力。"经典分布"那个世界的每步收益、"接单与冷却"里的报价、"报童问题"里每天的需求，都是这样生成的。
en: At every step a fresh draw is made from the same distribution, unrelated to what was drawn before. In this case the past has no predictive power at all for the future. The per-step returns of the "Classic distributions" world, the offers in "Job offers", and each day's demand in "Newsvendor" are all generated this way.

zh: 极端值出现得比正态分布预言的频繁。金融收益普遍是厚尾的。
en: Extreme values occur more often than the normal distribution predicts. Financial returns are generally heavy-tailed.

zh: 偏度 / 峰度
en: Skewness / kurtosis

zh: 偏度量分布左右是否对称，负的表示左边的尾巴更长。峰度量尾巴的厚度，正态分布是 3。
en: Skewness measures whether the distribution is symmetric between left and right; a negative value means the left tail is longer. Kurtosis measures how heavy the tails are; for the normal distribution it is 3.

zh: z 分数
en: z-score

zh: 一个值离均值有几个标准差：z = (值 − 均值)/标准差。规则里的均值和标准差取自最近的一段窗口：z 是 −2，说的是价格比近期的平均低了两个标准差。
en: How many standard deviations a value is from the mean: z = (value − mean)/standard deviation. In the rules, the mean and the standard deviation are taken from a recent window: z of −2 says that the price is two standard deviations below its recent average.

zh: 一个序列与它自己滞后若干步之后的相关系数。量的是"过去能不能线性地预测未来"。
en: The correlation coefficient between a series and the same series lagged by some number of steps. It measures "whether the past can linearly predict the future".

zh: 滞后
en: Lag

zh: 往回数几步。滞后 k 就是 k 步之前的那个值。
en: Counting back some number of steps. Lag k is the value k steps earlier.

zh: 规则算均线、波动时往回看的步数。"滚动窗口"另有所指：把一段真实的历史切成很多段互相重叠的小段，每段当作一条路径。
en: The number of steps a rule looks back when it computes a moving average or the volatility. "Rolling windows" refers to something else: cutting a stretch of real history into many short, mutually overlapping segments and treating each segment as a path.

zh: 平稳
en: Stationary

zh: 一个随机过程的统计性质不随时间变。在过去的数据上学到的东西到将来还适用，靠的就是这个假设。
en: The statistical properties of a stochastic process do not change over time. It is this assumption that lets what was learned on past data still apply in the future.

zh: 价格本身的高低；与"收益"（相邻两步之间的变化）相对。
en: How high or low the price itself is; as opposed to "return" (the change between two adjacent steps).

zh: 常见的分布
en: Common distributions

zh: 均匀分布 U(a, b)
en: Uniform U(a, b)

zh: a 到 b 之间的每个数等可能。U(0, 1) 就是在 0 到 1 之间随便取一个数。
en: Every number between a and b is equally likely. U(0, 1) means picking a number at random between 0 and 1.

zh: 正态分布 N(μ, σ²)
en: Normal N(μ, σ²)

zh: 钟形曲线，均值 μ，标准差 σ（括号里的第二个数是方差）。N(150, 45²) 就是均值 150、标准差 45。绝大多数取值落在均值上下两三个标准差以内。
en: The bell curve, with mean μ and standard deviation σ (the second number in the parentheses is the variance). N(150, 45²) means mean 150 and standard deviation 45. The vast majority of values fall within two or three standard deviations above or below the mean.

zh: 对数正态分布
en: Lognormal

zh: 一个量的对数服从正态分布。它只取正数，右边拖着一条长尾巴：多数时候不大，偶尔很大。
en: A quantity whose logarithm follows a normal distribution. It takes only positive values and trails a long tail on the right: most of the time it is not large, and occasionally it is very large.

zh: 只取正数，越大越少见，密度按指数衰减；Exp(1) 的均值是 1。常用来描述"下一个要等多久"。
en: It takes only positive values, larger values are rarer, and the density decays exponentially; Exp(1) has mean 1. It is often used to describe "how long until the next one".

zh: 帕累托分布
en: Pareto

zh: 尾巴按幂律衰减的分布：超过 x 的概率与 x 的 −α 次方成正比。α 越小尾巴越厚，极大的值越常见；α 不超过 2 时方差是无穷大。
en: A distribution whose tail decays as a power law: the probability of exceeding x is proportional to x raised to the power −α. The smaller α is, the heavier the tail and the more common extremely large values are; when α does not exceed 2, the variance is infinite.

zh: Student-t 分布
en: Student-t

zh: 长得像正态、尾巴更厚的分布。自由度越小尾巴越厚；自由度是 3 的时候方差有限，但峰度是无穷大。
en: A distribution that looks like the normal but has heavier tails. The fewer the degrees of freedom, the heavier the tails; with 3 degrees of freedom the variance is finite but the kurtosis is infinite.

zh: Beta(a, b) 分布
en: Beta(a, b)

zh: 取值在 0 到 1 之间，常用来表示"对一个概率的看法"：开始时一无所知，看到 a − 1 次成功、b − 1 次失败之后，对成功率的看法就是 Beta(a, b)。Thompson 抽样用的就是它。
en: It takes values between 0 and 1 and is often used to represent "a belief about a probability": starting from knowing nothing, after seeing a − 1 successes and b − 1 failures, the belief about the success rate is Beta(a, b). It is what Thompson sampling uses.

zh: 柯西分布
en: Cauchy

zh: 尾巴厚到连均值都不存在的分布：样本再多，平均值也不收敛。
en: A distribution whose tails are so heavy that even the mean does not exist: however many samples there are, the sample average does not converge.

zh: 行情的性质
en: Properties of market prices

zh: 布朗运动（dW）
en: Brownian motion (dW)

zh: 连续时间里的随机游走：每一小段时间里的变动互相独立、服从正态，方差等于这段时间的长度。公式里的 dW 是它在一小段时间 dt 里的增量。
en: A random walk in continuous time: the changes over small time intervals are independent of one another and normally distributed, with variance equal to the length of the interval. The dW in the formulas is its increment over a small time interval dt.

zh: 价格的对数做带漂移的布朗运动，写成 dS/S = μ dt + σ dW：每一小段时间里，价格的涨跌幅 = 平均的涨幅 μ dt，加上随机的一下 σ dW。简称 GBM。
en: The logarithm of the price follows a Brownian motion with drift, written dS/S = μ dt + σ dW: over each small time interval, the proportional change in the price = the average rise μ dt, plus a random kick σ dW. GBM for short.

zh: 偏离了某个水平之后倾向于回来。它既是一种现象，也是一个世界和一类规则的名字。
en: The tendency to come back after moving away from some level. It is both a phenomenon and the name of a world and of a class of rules.

zh: 半衰期
en: Half-life

zh: 均值回复的过程里，偏离缩小一半所需的时间，等于 ln 2/κ（κ 是回复的速度）。
en: In a mean-reverting process, the time it takes for a deviation to shrink by half, equal to ln 2/κ (κ is the reversion speed).

zh: 动量 / 趋势
en: Momentum / trend

zh: 涨过的倾向于继续涨，跌过的倾向于继续跌。
en: What has risen tends to keep rising, and what has fallen tends to keep falling.

zh: 反转
en: Reversal

zh: 涨过的倾向于回落，跌过的倾向于反弹。与动量相反。
en: What has risen tends to fall back, and what has fallen tends to rebound. The opposite of momentum.

zh: 波动聚集
en: Volatility clustering

zh: 大的涨跌之后容易跟着大的涨跌（方向不定）。波动本身有记忆。
en: Large moves tend to be followed by large moves (in either direction). Volatility itself has memory.

zh: 均线 / 上穿 / 下穿
en: Moving average / crossing above / crossing below

zh: 均线是最近 n 步价格的平均值，每走一步重算一次。短均线从下方升到长均线之上叫上穿，反过来叫下穿。
en: A moving average is the average of the prices over the most recent n steps, recomputed at every step. The short moving average rising from below to above the long moving average is called crossing above; the reverse is called crossing below.

zh: 技术分析
en: Technical analysis

zh: 只看过去的价格图形来判断买卖。"支撑位""头肩顶"是其中图形的名字。
en: Deciding when to buy and sell by looking only at charts of past prices. "Support level" and "head-and-shoulders top" are names of chart patterns in it.

zh: 市场与机构
en: Markets and institutions

zh: 指数 / 指数基金
en: Index / index fund

zh: 指数是一篮子股票的平均价（标普 500 是美国 500 家大公司，道琼斯指数是 30 家）。指数基金照着指数原样买入，不挑不选。
en: An index is the average price of a basket of stocks (the S&P 500 is 500 large US companies, the Dow Jones index 30). An index fund buys exactly what is in the index, without picking or choosing.

zh: 主动管理
en: Active management

zh: 由基金经理选股、择时，想跑赢指数。与指数基金相对。
en: A fund manager picks stocks and times the market, trying to beat the index. The opposite of an index fund.

zh: 共同基金 / 对冲基金
en: Mutual fund / hedge fund

zh: 共同基金面向公众募集。对冲基金只面向少数大额投资者，可以做空、加杠杆。
en: A mutual fund raises money from the public. A hedge fund is open only to a small number of large investors and can go short and use leverage.

zh: 自营
en: Proprietary trading

zh: 公司拿自己的钱交易，不替客户管钱。
en: A firm trades with its own money and does not manage money for clients.

zh: 清盘线
en: Liquidation line

zh: 基金合同里约定的净值下限，跌破就要停止运作、把剩下的钱退回去。
en: The lower limit on wealth stipulated in the fund contract; if wealth falls below it, the fund must stop operating and return the remaining money.

zh: 期货 / 管理期货基金
en: Futures / managed futures fund

zh: 期货是约定在将来某一天按现在讲定的价格买卖某样东西（股指、债券、原油、外汇）的标准化合约，做多做空同样方便。管理期货基金专门在各种期货上做趋势跟踪。
en: A futures contract is a standardized contract to buy or sell something (a stock index, bonds, crude oil, foreign exchange) on a set day in the future at a price agreed now; going long and going short are equally easy. Managed futures funds specialize in trend following across all kinds of futures.

zh: 期权
en: Option

zh: 一份合约：买方付一笔钱，换来在约定的日子按约定的价格（行权价）买入某样东西的权利，可以不用；用它叫行权。赌涨的叫看涨期权；到期前随时能行权的叫美式期权；到期时价格过线就付一笔固定的钱、否则一分不付的叫数字期权。卖出期权的人平时稳收小钱，偶尔赔一大笔。
en: A contract: the buyer pays a sum of money in exchange for the right to buy something on an agreed day at an agreed price (the strike price), a right that need not be used; using it is called exercising. One that bets on a rise is called a call option; one that can be exercised at any time before expiration is called an American option; one that pays a fixed sum if the price is past a set level at expiration, and nothing otherwise, is called a digital option. The seller of options steadily collects small sums most of the time and occasionally loses a large one.

zh: 1973 年的期权定价公式，假设股价是几何布朗运动、波动不变。"Black–Scholes 的世界"说的就是这个假设成立的理想市场。
en: The option pricing formula of 1973, which assumes that the stock price is a geometric Brownian motion with constant volatility. "The Black–Scholes world" means the idealized market in which this assumption holds.

zh: 拿同一到期日、不同行权价的期权的市价，各自倒推出"市场认为的波动率"，画出来两头高、中间低。如果波动真是常数，这条线应该是平的。
en: Take the market prices of options with the same expiration date and different strike prices, back out from each "the volatility the market believes in", and plot the results: high at both ends and low in the middle. If volatility really were constant, this line would be flat.

zh: 复制
en: Replication

zh: 用一套不断调整的买卖，做出和某份合约到期时一模一样的盈亏。
en: Using a set of continually adjusted trades to produce exactly the same profit and loss as a given contract has at expiration.

zh: 套利 / 统计套利
en: Arbitrage / statistical arbitrage

zh: 套利是同一样东西（或价值被合约绑在一起的两样东西）在两处价格不同时，买便宜的、卖贵的。统计套利没有合约保证，只是统计上倾向于合拢。
en: Arbitrage is buying the cheap one and selling the expensive one when the same thing (or two things whose values are tied together by a contract) has different prices in two places. Statistical arbitrage has no contractual guarantee; the prices merely tend, statistically, to converge.

zh: 高频
en: High-frequency trading

zh: 靠速度取胜的交易，一笔持仓只拿几毫秒到几秒。
en: Trading that wins on speed, holding each position for only a few milliseconds to a few seconds.

zh: 当天买进的股票，要到下一个交易日才能卖出。
en: Shares bought today cannot be sold until the next trading day.

zh: 涨跌停
en: Price limits

zh: 一天之内价格相对前一天收盘价能涨跌的最大幅度。到了涨停价基本买不进，到了跌停价基本卖不出。
en: The largest amount by which the price may rise or fall within one day relative to the previous day's closing price. At the limit-up price it is practically impossible to buy, and at the limit-down price it is practically impossible to sell.

zh: 封板 / 开板
en: Locked at the limit / the lock breaks

zh: 封板是涨停价上排满买单、没人肯卖（跌停相反）。开板是价格离开了涨停价。
en: Locked at the limit means that buy orders are queued up at the limit-up price and nobody is willing to sell (the reverse at limit-down). The lock breaks when the price moves away from the limit-up price.

zh: 风险警示股票（ST）
en: Risk-warning stocks (ST)

zh: 被交易所提示有退市等风险的股票，名字前带 ST。
en: Stocks that the exchange has flagged as carrying risks such as delisting; their names are prefixed with ST.

zh: 两种常见的执行算法。TWAP 按时间平均，把大单匀速拆到各个时段。VWAP 按成交量加权：市场成交多的时段多卖、少的时段少卖，让自己的成交均价贴近全市场当天的均价。
en: Two common execution algorithms. TWAP averages over time, splitting a large order at a constant rate across the time slots. VWAP weights by volume: it sells more in the slots where the market trades more and less in the slots where it trades less, so that its own average execution price stays close to the whole market's average price for the day.

zh: 执行缺口
en: Implementation shortfall

zh: 实际卖得的钱，比"全部按决定卖出那一刻的价格成交"少了多少。大单执行的成本基准。
en: How much less money the sale actually brought in than "everything filled at the price at the moment the decision to sell was made". The cost benchmark for executing large orders.

zh: 有效前沿
en: Efficient frontier

zh: 所有"期望成本和方差不可能同时再降"的方案连成的曲线。选哪一点取决于你有多怕风险。
en: The curve formed by all the schedules for which "expected cost and variance cannot both be lowered any further". Which point to choose depends on how much you fear risk.

zh: 概率与决策
en: Probability and decisions

zh: 鞅
en: Martingale

zh: 一个"公平游戏"：以到目前为止的全部信息为条件，下一步的期望等于当前值。没有优势的赌局里，资金是一个鞅。平均只会往下走的叫上鞅。
en: A "fair game": conditional on all the information up to now, the expected value at the next step equals the current value. In a gamble with no edge, the bankroll is a martingale. One that on average can only go down is called a supermartingale.

zh: 停时
en: Stopping time

zh: 一个只依赖过去和现在的"什么时候停"的规则。可选停时定理说：在适当的条件下，公平游戏在任何停时处停下来仍然是公平的。
en: A rule for "when to stop" that depends only on the past and the present. The optional stopping theorem says: under suitable conditions, a fair game stopped at any stopping time is still fair.

zh: 从最后一步往前倒推：先算出"到了每个状态之后的最优值"，再决定前一步怎么走。
en: Working backward from the last step: first compute "the optimal value from each state onward", then decide what to do at the step before.

zh: 你的累计得分，比事后看来最好的那个固定做法少了多少。在线学习和老虎机问题用它衡量算法。
en: How much your cumulative score falls short of that of the fixed course of action that looks best in hindsight. Online learning and bandit problems use it to measure algorithms.

zh: 去试不了解的选项（探索），还是用目前看来最好的（利用）。老虎机问题的核心矛盾。
en: Whether to try options you know little about (exploration) or to use the one that looks best so far (exploitation). The central tension of the bandit problem.

zh: 报童问题的最优订货量所在的分位数：缺货损失 /（缺货损失 + 积压损失）。
en: The quantile at which the optimal order quantity of the newsvendor problem lies: stockout loss / (stockout loss + overstock loss).

zh: 逆向选择
en: Adverse selection

zh: 对方只在对他有利的时候才成交，所以"成交了"本身就是坏消息。赢家诅咒的来源。
en: The counterparty trades only when it is favorable to them, so "the deal went through" is itself bad news. The source of the winner's curse.

zh: 机会成本
en: Opportunity cost

zh: 为了做这件事而放弃的、本来能得到的东西。
en: What you could have had but gave up in order to do this.

zh: 模型与算法
en: Models and algorithms

zh: 喂给模型的输入，比如最近几步的收益。
en: An input fed to the model, for example the returns of the last few steps.

zh: 训练集 / 验证集
en: Training set / validation set

zh: 用来拟合模型的数据，和留出来检查模型的数据。验证集上的表现才算数。
en: The data used to fit the model, and the data held out to check the model. Only performance on the validation set counts.

zh: 模型解释了目标的方差的多大比例。验证集上不大于 0，表示还不如直接猜平均值。
en: The fraction of the variance of the target that the model explains. A value no greater than 0 on the validation set means the model does no better than guessing the average outright.

zh: 预测值与实际值之间的相关系数。预测校准时（实际值对预测值做回归，斜率是 1、截距是 0，比如真实的条件期望）它等于 √R²；一般只有 IC² ≥ R²：把预测整体放大或缩小，IC 不变，R² 却会下降，甚至变成负的。按预测的大小下注时，每一步的夏普约等于它。
en: The correlation coefficient between predicted and actual values. When the prediction is calibrated (regressing the actual values on the predicted values gives slope 1 and intercept 0, as with the true conditional expectation) it equals √R²; in general only IC² ≥ R² holds: scaling the prediction up or down as a whole leaves IC unchanged, but R² falls and can even become negative. When you bet in proportion to the size of the prediction, the Sharpe ratio per step is approximately equal to it.

zh: 方向命中率
en: Directional hit rate

zh: 预测对了涨跌方向的比例。
en: The share of predictions that got the direction of the move right.

zh: 模型假设的结构恰好就是数据真实的生成方式。
en: The structure assumed by the model is exactly the way the data is really generated.

zh: 时间复杂度
en: Time complexity

zh: 输入规模增大时，计算量按什么速度增长。O(n) 是成正比，O(n²) 是按平方，O(1) 是与规模无关。
en: How fast the amount of computation grows as the input size increases. O(n) means in proportion to the size, O(n²) in proportion to its square, and O(1) independent of the size.

zh: 空间复杂度
en: Space complexity

zh: 算法运行时需要记住多少东西，同样用 O(·) 表示。
en: How much an algorithm needs to remember while it runs, likewise expressed with O(·).

zh: 状态（规则的记忆）
en: State (the rule's memory)

zh: 规则在两步之间自己记着的东西：有没有持仓、当前的注码、各档出价的战绩。规则下面写"不带状态"，是说它自己什么都不记（多臂老虎机里各台的次数和中奖数由裁判记着、每回合交给规则，所以那几条规则也是"不带状态"）；"开局时自带状态 3 个数"，是说它的记事本里一开始有 3 个数；"开局时状态是空的"，是说记事本一开始是空的，之后边跑边往里记。
en: What the rule itself keeps in memory between two steps: whether it holds a position, the current stake, the track record of each bid level. "Stateless" written under a rule means that it remembers nothing itself (in the multi-armed bandit, each arm's pull count and win count are kept by the referee and handed to the rule every round, so those rules are also "Stateless"); "Initial state: 3 numbers" means that its notebook holds 3 numbers at the start; "State starts empty" means that the notebook is empty at the start and is filled in as the rule runs.

zh: 纳秒 / 微秒 / 毫秒
en: Nanosecond / microsecond / millisecond

zh: 一秒的十亿分之一、百万分之一、千分之一。规则做一次决定通常是几十到几百纳秒；训练一个模型通常是几毫秒到几秒。
en: One billionth, one millionth and one thousandth of a second. A rule usually takes tens to hundreds of nanoseconds to make one decision; training a model usually takes a few milliseconds to a few seconds.

zh: 在线 / 离线
en: Online / offline

zh: 在线算法：数据一个一个地来，每来一个就立刻更新、立刻决策，不回头重算；每步的时间和存储都应当与已经过去多久无关。离线：事先在一批数据上一次算好。
en: An online algorithm: the data points arrive one at a time, and with each arrival it updates and decides immediately, without going back to recompute; the time and memory per step should both be independent of how much time has already passed. Offline: computed once, in advance, on a batch of data.

zh: 只记着"现在处于哪种情形"的几个标记，每一步按标记和新来的数据决定动作、更新标记。
en: It remembers only a few flags for "which situation it is in now"; at each step it uses the flags and the newly arrived data to decide the action and to update the flags.
